learning_outcomes.text: Proper implementation of specific fundamental knowledge of mathematics, physics, chemistry, in the field of electrical engineering
The application of theoretical results and methods of mathematical analysis for solving engineering problems
Calculus of partial derivatives and solving problems of extremal values
Calculus of improper integrals, line integrals, double and triple integrals, surface integrals

syllabus_topics: Differential calculus on real axis and Taylor formula
Gradient, Iacobi matrix, differentiation of composed functions
Taylor formula for functions of several variables
